quickQuestions.en: How can I reach a leader?

fallback.a_en: Sorry, hindi ko masigurado ’yan — and I don’t want to guess. The best move is to email the team at ftb.youngpro.ministry@gmail.com and a leader will get back to you. You can also just come to the next YP Fellowship and say hi!
fallback.a_tl: Pasensya, hindi ko masigurado ’yan — ayoko namang manghula. Best na i-email mo ang team sa ftb.youngpro.ministry@gmail.com at may leader na sasagot sa’yo. Pwede ka rin namang dumalo sa susunod na YP Fellowship at magpakilala!

greeting.a_en: Hi! I’m the YP helper. Ask me anything about the FTB Young Pro Ministry — when we meet, how to join, our events, or our themes. English or Tagalog, parehong okay!
greeting.a_tl: Hi! Ako ang YP helper. Itanong mo lang ang kahit ano tungkol sa FTB Young Pro Ministry — kung kailan kami nagkikita, paano sumali, mga events, o mga tema namin. English man o Tagalog, okay lang!
